name: Cleric Word Domains
body:
Whenever you gain a domain, you may instead gain the equivalent Word domain instead. This replaces the domain powers and domain spells.

Beginning at 1st level, you may now use the first Word associated with your domain once per day, treating your cleric level as your Speaker level. Learn the following Identifying Words: All, Ally, Enemy, and Self.

At 6th level you gain the second Word associated with your domain and may use it once per day. The Words associated with each domain are as follows:

This ability functions as the Words of Foundation class feature from Speaker, except you use Wisdom instead of Intelligence.
